title: Otsuka posts phase 3b ADHD trial win ahead of looming FDA approval decision
summary: A phase 3b trial of Otsuka’s attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder prospect has hit its primary endpoint, strengthening the drugmaker’s hand weeks before a potential U.S. launch of the therapy.

title: Ollin hauls in $330M to enlist Vabysmo challenger in phase 3 eye disease gauntlet
summary: Half a year after toppling Genentech’s eye medicine giant Vabysmo in an early trial, Texas biotech Ollin Biosciences has lassoed a $330 million series B to push its winning contender through a multi-trial phase 3 gauntlet.

title: AbbVie’s $11B Apogee Acquisition Brings an Eczema Drug With an Edge
summary: Apogee Therapeutics brings AbbVie a long-acting antibody ready for Phase 3 testing in atopic dermatitis, also called eczema. This therapy’s pipeline in a product potential includes respiratory conditions such as asthma — as a monotherapy and as part of novel drug combinations. summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.

title: Discreet biotech Osanni Bio starts making noise with $190M series B for clinical push
summary: An under-the-radar Bay Area biotech has brought in a $190 million series B with the goal of hatching a clutch of new companies to fly its drug candidates forward.

title: Merck KGaA pledges $50M to build new cardio biotech with eye to later acquisition
summary: Merck KGaA has committed $50 million to build a new biotech with prolific life science investor Versant Ventures, with the ultimate goal of devouring the NewCo down the line.

title: Cadence Rakes In $100M to Automate Chronic Care at Scale
summary: Cadence raised $100 million in Series C funding to scale its AI-powered chronic care platform, which monitors patients at home and adjusts their medications in real time. The startup, now valued at $1.23 billion, partners with health systems to treat patients with heart failure, hypertension and diabetes. title: FDA drops blood pressure device enforcement against Whoop
summary: The FDA has sent an End of Enforcement notice to consumer wearable device company Whoop, putting a formal end to the agency’s investigation into its blood pressure tech use.
